description: This file defines the WNTerrains class, which manages terrain data for the Wesnoth Scenario Editor. It initializes terrain objects from a configuration file, provides accessors for terrain properties, and handles terrain-related data structures.

classes.name: WNTerrains
classes.description: Manages terrain data for the Wesnoth Scenario Editor, including initialization from configuration files and providing access to terrain properties.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes terrain data from terrain.cfg file, creating terrain objects and handling special 'Keep' terrains for code 'K'.

methods.name: terrainAtIndex
methods.description: Returns the terrain object at the specified index.

methods.name: initialised
methods.description: Returns whether terrains have been initialized.

methods.name: count
methods.description: Returns the total number of terrains loaded.

methods.name: terrainForCode
methods.description: Finds the index of the terrain with the specified code string.

methods.name: terrainForChar
methods.description: Finds the index of the terrain with the specified character code.

methods.name: codeAtIndex
methods.description: Returns the terrain code at the specified index.

methods.name: resizeTo
methods.description: Resizes the terrain array objects to a new size.
